name: Judah
summary: Jacob's fourth son, born to Leah. He urged his brothers to sell Joseph, but later offered himself as a slave in Benjamin's place, and Jacob said the right to rule would not leave Judah.

key_moments.title: Selling Joseph
key_moments.description: Judah asked his brothers what they would gain by killing Joseph, and urged them to sell him instead. They sold Joseph for twenty pieces of silver to traders who took him to Egypt.

key_moments.title: Judah and Tamar
key_moments.description: Judah did not give his widowed daughter-in-law Tamar to his youngest son as he had promised. She disguised herself and conceived by Judah, and when he learned the truth, he said she was more righteous than he was.

key_moments.title: Promising to Bring Benjamin
key_moments.description: When the family needed grain from Egypt again, Judah told Jacob he would answer for Benjamin's safety himself. Jacob let Benjamin go.

key_moments.title: Offering Himself
key_moments.description: When Benjamin was accused of stealing Joseph's cup, Judah pleaded with Joseph. He offered to stay as a slave in Benjamin's place, so that his father would not die of grief.

key_moments.title: A Young Lion
key_moments.description: Jacob said Judah's brothers would praise him and bow before him, and called him a young lion. He said the scepter would not leave Judah until Shiloh came.
